resolutions.knock_on: This is the same root cause as R8. The _demo assertion round 2 used to 'prove' §b2a bullet 1 was `cell[0] <= imgs[3]["offset"] <= cell[1]` on `cell` -- an image TRAILING its cell's text, whose offset equals the cell's exclusive end. That assertion only passed because of the inclusive comparison R7 names. Under the correct convention that shape is outside its own cell, which is why R7's fix and R8's rewrite land together.

resolutions.summary: ADR-032 §b2a's mechanism rewritten from scratch and now derived rather than generalised from one example. The rule that is actually true: an emits nothing, so its offset is the position the text run had reached; spans are tightened to their first/last VISIBLE character and empty cells clamped into the table; containment is half-open. Therefore an image lands inside a span ONLY when that span's own visible text begins exactly at the mark and continues past it. 'The cell carries text' is explicitly named as not the condition.
resolutions.reproduction:
Confirmed, and the finding understates it. Asserting bullet 1 as committed against all three text-carrying-cell shapes at once shows it false for TWO of three, not one: `cell` offset 8 vs cell (4, 8) -> outside (trailing, R7's boundary); `adj` offset 9 vs cell (9, 12) -> inside; `
blocked
` offset 12 vs cell (13, 20) -> outside its cell, but INSIDE the table (4, 20) because the neighbouring cells' text widens the table span -- a fourth distinct outcome neither the finding nor either previous ADR wording had.
resolutions.covered_by: src/sec10k/normalize.py::_demo -- five assertions, one per position, on one synthetic table plus a trailing image: (1) image trailing its cell's text -> at the cell's exclusive end, outside; (2) image immediately followed by its cell's text -> inside, the only such shape; (3) block emitter intervening -> outside its cell, inside the table; (4) image-only leading row -> outside the whole table via the clamp (the corpus shape); (5) image after -> at the table's exclusive end, outside. ADR-032 §b2a carries the same five as a table.
